de1.P4.C3.ghi_chu: Anh image10.png doc duoc la 129 m^2 (khong phai 84 nhu loi giai mau), hinh san bong ro khong co trong cau luu nen khong kiem chung duoc cong thuc y a S(x) = -x^2 + 30x; mau luyen y b lai dung phuong trinh x^2 + 10x - 84 = 0 (x = 6, quang duong 30 m), khong nhat quan voi cong thuc y a. Can hinh va de goc.

de1.P4.C6.ghi_chu: Y c da kiem chung dung: anh de cho OM = 2R nen BC = R can 3 (phuong an C). Nhung chua xac nhan toan cau vi khung y a dung ten diem A, B, C va goc OMA/ONA trong khi de dung diem ngoai la M (OM = 2R), con khung y b ghep ten tam giac khong thanh ten tam giac (o 'AB' + 'D' + 'O'). Nho thay doi chieu hinh va ten diem goc truoc khi duyet.
